prompt: Spaghetti Junction, Birmingham, from 300 metres at a slant: the stacked concrete flyovers of the interchange all packed with stopped evacuation traffic, a mat of tail lights under sodium lamps. Small figures climb the grass embankments away from the road. Tower-block windows along the canal are half dark. Far behind the city centre a substation fireball lights the low cloud from underneath. 24mm aerial. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
